title: Price-Protection Uplift Table (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
# Cartwise Grocery Orders price-protection uplift table

The price-protection refund on a replacement line is raised by an order uplift before the refund is rounded to the cent: the amount is multiplied by one plus the uplift percentage divided by 100, and the result is rounded to the cent once.

| Condition on the order | Uplift |
| --- | --- |
| Already carries an item refund for a missing, damaged, wrong item or quality issue, and its item subtotal is at least 125.00 | 10 percent |
| Already carries such an item refund, and its item subtotal is below 125.00 | 5 percent |
| Carries no such item refund | not raised |

Notes to the table:

1. An item refund for a missing, damaged, wrong item or quality issue is an item refund entry standing on the order with one of those four refund reasons; one entry suffices.
2. The item subtotal is the sum of the order's billed item lines.
3. An item subtotal of exactly 125.00 falls in the 10 percent row; 124.99 falls in the 5 percent row.

Hypothetical illustration: an amount of 1.20 before rounding becomes 1.32 at 10 percent and 1.26 at 5 percent, and stays 1.20 when the order carries no such item refund.
